title: Extremely engaging for kids
text: Let me start by how kid friendly the tour is. Our guid Montse was such an engaging person especially with the children. They totally loved her. She was super proactive is communicating even before the tour started as well as after we finished by providing guides and advice on best places and recommendations. And when the kids were to tired to continue she didn’t show any resentment or bad feeling towards them and made sure that they see the important things before saying goodbye. It was really fun.
author: Reem A
